resources.string: A few one-time steps. After that, the helper starts by itself. Each step ticks itself off when you come back to this screen.
Your phone runs Android %1$s. On this version, WhtsAgent Helper has to be started from a computer after every restart.
Your phone is rooted, so one tap starts the helper.
Open About phone and tap Build number 7 times (on Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO: OS version or MIUI version). Enter your PIN if asked, then come back.
Connect to Wi-Fi. Then in Developer options, turn on USB debugging and Wireless debugging.
In Developer options, turn on USB debugging.
Tap the words Wireless debugging (not the switch), then Pair device with pairing code. Type the 6-digit code into the WhtsAgent Helper notification.
Tap Start. From now on, the helper starts by itself after the phone restarts (when it\'s on Wi-Fi).
Connect the phone to a computer by USB and run this command. Repeat after every restart.\n\n%1$s
Turn on Developer options first: tap Build number 7 times (on Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO: OS version or MIUI version).
Wireless debugging needs Wi-Fi. Turn on Wi-Fi and connect to a network, then tap Start again.
Tap Build number 7 times (on Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO: OS version), then come back.
Turn on USB debugging, then Wireless debugging (highlighted), then come back.
Open Wireless debugging, then tap Pair device with pairing code. Type the code in the WhtsAgent Helper notification.
Tap Start and allow root access when asked.
WhtsAgent Helper is running and starts by itself after a restart.
WhtsAgent Helper is running. Start it again after each restart.
